description: Using the Splunk Enterprise web interface, add a new data input to monitor the /var/log/kern.log file. First, log in to Splunk using username 'admin' and password 'SplunkAdmin1!'. Then navigate to Settings > Data Inputs > Files & Directories, click 'New Local File & Directory', enter the path /var/log/kern.log, set the source type to 'syslog', and select the 'system_logs' index as the target index (do NOT use the default 'main' index). Complete the wizard to save the new monitor input. The Splunk web interface is at http://localhost:8000.
